reviews.comment: Don't be scared about the older reviews - he used to teach a methods class at Texas A & M that was apparently really hard. I had him for Authoritarian Politics at WashU and it was a good class. A decent amount of reading and not easy, but reasonable and most people got As and Bs.

I took Dr. Horz's Authoritarian Politics class and found most of the poor reviews to be inaccurate. He's passionate about the subject and clearly outlines class expectations. He can be a little awkward at times, but is very accessible outside of class. Readings can be dense, but he often tells you sections to focus on and his slides help as well.

One of the worst class experiences that I had. We were not prepared for the test, lectures were overly complex and confusing, help was very hard to find, and most of the class ended up dropping the class. All but one of the survivors had a C or below until we all emailed the Dean of the Bush School. Never take this class with Dr. Horz.

Horz's assignments were wildly difficult, often covering content that wasn't discussed in class. The readings were heavy. The small number of assignments and uneven weighting made it so that messing up on one assignment basically guarantees a bad grade. Youtube was necessary to learn everything to pass the course.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The only way to pass the class is by watching YouTube. The class was terrible, and when the professor gives you the grade distribution and 75% of the class is C or below (AFTER Q-drops), you begin to understand. I would normally give the class breakdown, but let me save you the trouble of wondering and just dont take this class with him. Just dont.

The hardest class I have ever taken in my college career. Horz is a terrible professor who doesn't care if his students pass or fail. The majority of his class was failing/had a C before the final exam. The only way for us to learn was by watching YouTube videos and meeting with classmates since his lectures were not helpful at all.

This was the worst class I have ever taken. Nothing against the professor as a person, but he didnt teach the class competently. I am one of many students who feel this way. DO NOT TAKE. Multiple hw problems were not taught in class or in textbook. 3/4 were failing or had a C halfway thru, majority of class failed midterm. Final was a train wreck.

Go to the ta sessions, they're the only ones that will help you with the course material. 4 problem sets, 2 written assignments. I never went to the lectures, but my TA, Murat, was amazing and so helpful. It is an easy class if you actually try and go to TA office hours. Ended up with a 100.25 because of the extra credit.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I only attended the lecture once the entire semester and ended with a high A. The class is VERY TA very, there is a lab on fridays that are led by the TA's and they are the ones to grade all your work. Make sure to go to office hours and start early because there's only like 6 assignments to do all semester long but some of them are long.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class gets a worse rap than it deserves. Carlo Horz is not a bad professor by any means, the class structure simply makes his job seem unimportant for the class. The class is extremely dependent on the TA that you have since they are the ones that teach you how to succeed on the research paper and the 2 problem sets. Good TA = Good Class
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This class was not good...like at all. The organization of it was terrible and although the TA's were nice and helpful the class itself sucked. Take a different professor if you can. I was confused the whole semester.
worst class ever

This is probably the most poorly setup class I have ever taken. This class consists of 2 problem sets each problem set is worth 15% of your grade and 1 research paper that is worth 65% of your semester grade. Unclear grading criteria, zero correlation between TA session and in-person lecture, don't take this if you're not a POLS major.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The material covered is difficult, but between the textbook, lectures, and the lab sections, there's plenty of opportunities to understand or ask questions. The assignments had plenty of instructions which made them fairly easy.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This is maybe the most poorly set-up class I have ever taken. Attendance was emailing professors/TAs questions about weekly labs and biweekly YouTube videos, and these videos really didn't teach anything that wasn't better explained in the book. Very difficult papers and homework assignments as well. Don't take this if you don't have to.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: This class is very hard, and online it was worse. The lectures are long, boring, and hard to follow. I will say that the final was easy, but only if you really tried on the review. You need to make friends in this class to learn collaboratively. Helped my section, at least. Would wait to take in person. Especially as it was 100% asynchronous.

One of the hardest classes I have taken, necessarily due to the content, but because of how tedious it is. Super hard grader that needs all the details to get full points. However, there is a super generous curve at the end of the semester, so that helps. Personally would not recommend, but it's a required course for POLS majors. Pay attention!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I took this class with Alejandro Medina as my TA. There were 2 lectures with Horz and 1 with Medina a week. It is a lot of coding and I suggest using dual monitors to watch them code and work along side. Attendance is 10% of your grade. There are 2 tests that were EXACTLY like the reviews. Also 3 easy problem sets they walk you through, worth 15%.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The class is hard because its a coding class AND a research methods class all jammed into 2 50min sections and a 50min TA small group. Definitely too much material to cover within the time. His vids also didn't offer much explanation, you just had to copy and paste everything. Midterm was hard but the final was easy and he curved final letter grade
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Never met Prof. Horz due to Covid. He would post two very long lectures to watch each week that were very boring and difficult to practice the coding exercises along with him. I would not have done well in this class without the TA session. The TA told us what we needed to know each week so well I stopped watching Horz's videos and still got an A.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy
